_comment: Issues #389 and #390 (F-TEST-003): reviewed DNS, TLS, QUIC, HTTP/2, S1AP, NGAP and NAS accuracy cases plus unknown/malformed traffic.
Checked by tools/ci/tests/check-accuracy-corpus.py; NOT part of ci/golden_pcaps.txt,
so the golden classification fingerprint's input set is unchanged.
expected counts are per packet: wire = carries the family's wire-protocol label,
other = attributed to a different application protocol, abstain = no application verdict;
attribution = application names the SDK derives heuristically beneath the wire label.
abstain counts include payload-less packets (e.g. TCP SYN/SYN-ACK/ACK), which carry no application data.

The 'unknown' family is the abstention family: no wire labels, cases of kind 'unknown' whose expected block states explicitly how many packets must get no application verdict (abstain) and which are still attributed (other).
SCTP chunk layers (sctp_data, ...) count as transport; a family wire label beneath another (nas_5g beneath ngap) is encapsulation, not attribution.

provenance.redistribution: Synthetic: every byte is produced by the generator from constants in the source tree (RFC 5737 documentation addresses, RFC 2606/6761 reserved names, locally administered MACs); no captured traffic, no third-party data. Redistributable under the repository licence.

cases.description: S1AP InitialUEMessage (EPS Attach Request, IMSI 001010123456789) on SCTP PPID 18 to port 36412.

provenance.redistribution: Synthetic: every byte is produced by the generator from constants in the source tree (RFC 5737 documentation addresses, locally administered MACs, 3GPP test PLMN 001/01 and test IMSI/SUCI MSIN 0123456789); no captured traffic, no third-party data, no real subscriber. Redistributable under the repository licence.

checks: TS 36.413 InitiatingMessage procedureCode 12 with eNB-UE-S1AP-ID, NAS-PDU, TAI, EUTRAN-CGI and RRC-Establishment-Cause (all mandatory IEs); APER bytes equal an independent pycrate encoding of the message and round-trip through its decoder unchanged
NAS-PDU is a TS 24.301 plain EMM Attach Request (KSI 7, EPS attach, IMSI, UE network capability, ESM PDN Connectivity Request) decoded by pycrate
SCTP common header + one DATA chunk (B/E set, chunk length excludes padding) with a valid RFC 9260 CRC32c; PPID 18 = S1AP (IANA), destination port 36412

observed while reviewing: the SDK's vendored S1AP decoder rejected this InitialUEMessage's IEs ('Decoding of S1ap_InitialUEMessage failed'), so s1ap.* attributes stayed empty; fixed in issue #427 (s1ap.procedure_code 12, s1ap.enb_ue_id 1, s1ap.imsi 001010123456789 are now extracted); classification is by PPID and unaffected

provenance.redistribution: Synthetic: every byte is produced by the generator from constants in the source tree (RFC 5737 documentation addresses, locally administered MACs, 3GPP test PLMN 001/01 and test IMSI/SUCI MSIN 0123456789); no captured traffic, no third-party data, no real subscriber. Redistributable under the repository licence.

checks: payload is byte-identical to acc_s1ap_positive; only the PPID differs (RFC 9260 allows PPID 0)
accepted handling: abstention -- proto_s1ap.c classifies on PPID 18 only and has no port/decode fallback (unlike NGAP), so real S1AP with PPID 0 is not recognised; recorded, not endorsed

checks: TS 38.413 InitiatingMessage procedureCode 15 with RAN-UE-NGAP-ID, NAS-PDU, UserLocationInformation (NR-CGI + TAI), RRCEstablishmentCause and UEContextRequest; APER bytes equal an independent pycrate encoding of the message and round-trip through its decoder unchanged
NAS-PDU is a TS 24.501 plain 5GMM Registration Request (ngKSI 7, FOR, initial registration, null-scheme SUCI) decoded by pycrate

packet 1 exercises PPID 60, packet 2 the PPID 0 + port 38412 + successful-decode fallback of proto_ngap.c; SDK extraction returns ngap.procedure_code 15, ran_ue_id 1 and nas_5g.message_type 65 for both
nas_5g beneath ngap is the NAS family's wire label: encapsulation, not heuristic attribution

checks: TS 38.413 DownlinkNASTransport (procedureCode 4: AMF-UE-NGAP-ID, RAN-UE-NGAP-ID, NAS-PDU) and UplinkNASTransport (procedureCode 46: the same plus UserLocationInformation); APER bytes equal an independent pycrate encoding of the message and round-trip through its decoder unchanged
